title: Vesper and the Ember
author: X. M. Okafor
blurb: August Ravensworth, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
